Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: At that time Moses and the sons of Israel sang this hymn of praise to God, and they all said together: 'Let us praise God, for He has triumphed mightily — the horse and its rider He hurled into the sea.'
translations.2: 'My strength and my glory is the Eternal, who was my salvation; this is my stronghold — I take refuge in Him; the God of my father — I exalt Him.'
translations.3: 'God is the master of battles — God is His name.'
translations.4: 'The chariots of Pharaoh and his army He swept away into the sea; and the choicest of his officers were drowned in the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea).'
translations.5: 'The deep covered them; they went down to the bottom like stones.'
translations.6: 'Your right hand, O Lord, is great in power; Your right hand, O Lord, strikes terror into the enemies.'
translations.7: 'And by Your abundant might You demolish Your adversaries; You send forth Your wrath — it consumes them like stubble.'
translations.8: 'And by the wind of Your anger the water was heaped up; the flowing waters stood still like towering mountains; and the deep was frozen in the heart of the sea.'
translations.9: 'When the enemy said: I will pursue them and overtake them, and divide their spoil — my soul shall have its fill of satisfaction from them; I shall draw my sword, and my hand shall cut them down.'
translations.10: 'You blew with Your wind and the sea covered them; and they sank like lead in the mighty water.'
translations.11: 'Who is like You among the worshipped, O Lord? Who is like You, the majestic and the holy — awesome in praise, the maker of wonders?'
translations.12: 'You stretched forth Your right hand — and the earth swallowed them.'
translations.13: 'And You led in Your grace the people whom You redeemed, and You guided them in Your might to Your holy dwelling.'
translations.14: 'The nations heard and trembled; and birth-pangs seized the inhabitants of Philistia.'
translations.15: 'At that time the chiefs of Edom were dismayed, and the nobles of Moab — trembling seized them; and all the inhabitants of Canaan were convulsed.'
translations.16: 'May dread and terror fall upon them; by the greatness of Your power may they be still as stone — until Your people pass over, O Lord; until the people pass over whom You have made Your own.'
translations.17: 'One by one You shall bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance — prepared as a dwelling for You; You have made it, O Lord, a holy abode; O Lord, Your hands have established it.'
translations.18: 'God is King for ever and ever.'
translations.19: For when the horses of Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen entered into the sea, God turned back upon them the waters of the sea; and the sons of Israel walked on the dry land in the midst of the sea.
translations.20: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and drums.
translations.21: And Miriam led them in response: 'Praise God, for He has triumphed mightily — the horse and its rider He hurled into the sea.'
translations.22: And Moses moved the sons of Israel on from the Sea of Qulzum, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they traveled three days in the wilderness and found no water.
translations.23: And they came to the Bitterness, and they could not drink water from it, for it was bitter; and therefore it was named the Bitterness.
translations.24: And the people murmured against Moses, saying: 'What shall we drink?'
translations.25: And he cried out to God; and He directed him to a tree, and he cast branches of it into the water, and it became sweet. There He established for them ordinances and laws, and there He put them to the test.
translations.26: And He said: 'If you accept the command of God your Lord, and do what is right in His sight, and hearken to His commandments, and keep all His ordinances — then all the diseases which I brought upon the Egyptians I shall bring upon you none of them, for I am God your healer.'
translations.27: Then they came to Elim, and there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there by the water.
